goal: Construct positive mobility changes invisible to all L1 slopes and prove the limit of any finite list of initial slope observations.
selection_reason: L1 resolves the cubic inside a three-parameter family but retains unrestricted-mobility ambiguity. L2 must make that ambiguity constructive and quantify positivity.
model: Fixed known conditional density rho_kappa on compact SU(2)^3, c>0 fixed; smooth strictly positive baseline mobility m0. General theorem concerns a finite set of smooth observables and only their initial imaginary-time slopes. Explicit polynomial fixture at kappa=0, baseline m0=1 and L1 observables f=x,g=x+x^2/4,h=x^2+x^3.
required: For N finite slope functionals L_j(P)=integral rho_kappa P(x) Gamma(f_j), construct a nonzero polynomial in a finite-dimensional nullspace. Justify nonzero as a function on full marginal support and normalize by a proved finite coefficient or sup norm bound.
Prove m_epsilon=m0+epsilon P remains positive for an explicit interval tied to inf m0 and ||P||infinity; all N initial slopes and the stationary density remain unchanged while the generator changes.

Do not extend finite-slope underidentification to complete time-correlation curves, full generators or data outside the finite list. Distinguish exact formal moment matrices from noisy numerical estimates.
Derive the proposed fifth polynomial as an explicit null direction for all three L1 rates, verify its positivity interval and nonzero generator residual.
Check the NIST Gegenbauer finite sum: any identification with C5^(2)/192 makes the polynomial classical, not a newly invented family.

Explain the operational workaround: declare a finite mobility basis, require a full-rank rate matrix, reserve observations to falsify the model class, and record physical matching as an independent task. Additional variables alone cannot establish uniqueness.
proposed_not_assumed: integral p5 Gamma(f)=integral p5 Gamma(g)=integral p5 Gamma(h)=0 at kappa=0
For m0>=m_star>0, normalize ||P||infinity<=1 and choose |epsilon|<=m_star/2 to retain m_epsilon>=m_star/2
At x=0, the change in A_m x from the p5 deformation is -epsilon/32, nonzero for epsilon!=0
acceptance: Constructive finite-data obstruction and exact positive hidden-direction fixture, preserving finite-family successful inverses and physical limits.
comparison_protocol: Standard deterministic independent report/check/results and complete source/output manifest. Both proof and scope matter; fixtures do not establish the general theorem by sampling.
